## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Suíyǒng zūnzhě jīng* (T505) is a one-fascicle Sòng-period sūtra by [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) Shīhù and his team. The protagonist *Suíyǒng* 隨勇 ("the Brave / Following Bravery") may be a Sòng-era rendering of Sanskrit *Anuruddha* (one of the Buddha's foremost disciples).

**Abstract**

A short Sòng translation on the merits and conduct of an arhat-disciple. Translation dated to Shīhù's productive period (989–1017 CE).
